cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit + NVIDIA driver
cuda.note: Use NVIDIA's supported CUDA repository/installer for this exact Ubuntu release; package names vary by CUDA release. The forge will not mix releases.

rocm.label: AMD ROCm + HIP
rocm.note: For Ubuntu 24.04, use AMD's current ROCm package-manager instructions. For Ubuntu 26.04, the forge refuses to add a 24.04/noble repository because the current AMD native-install documentation does not list 26.04 as a supported Ubuntu target.

sycl.label: Intel oneAPI DPC++ / Level Zero
sycl.note: Use Intel's current oneAPI APT package intel-oneapi-compiler-dpcpp-cpp. The forge also detects an existing /opt/intel/oneapi installation and loads setvars.sh automatically for CMake/build steps.
